title: pilosella piloselloides subsp. parciflocca
intro: Pilosella piloselloides subsp. parciflocca, commonly known as a subspecies of the False Hawk's Beak, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is used for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and it may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella piloselloides subsp. parciflocca include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been found to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
